prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a sideswipe while changing lanes in Conroe, Texas, and has back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1237; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thanks for taking the time to speak with me today. This call is being recorded for claim purposes. Do you understand and consent to that?

A: Yes, I understand.

Q: Can you tell me in your own words what happened on the day of the accident?

A: I was driving in the right lane on the highway near Conroe, Texas, and I signaled to move into the left lane because traffic had slowed up ahead. I checked my mirror and it looked clear. As I started to move over, another vehicle came up alongside me and we sideswiped each other. I felt a hard jolt and my car pulled toward the median.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before you began your lane change?

A: I didn't see it in my mirror when I checked, but I think it was in my blind spot. I didn't turn my head to look over my shoulder, which I probably should have done.

Q: Where did the two vehicles make contact?

A: The passenger side of my car, the rear door area, and the driver side of the other vehicle's front fender area.

Q: Were you injured in the accident?

A: Yes. My lower back hurts quite a bit. I felt it tighten up right away, and the pain has gotten worse over the last couple of days.

Q: Have you sought medical treatment?

A: I went to an urgent care clinic that same afternoon. They examined me, took some X-rays, and told me I had a back strain. They gave me a prescription for muscle relaxers and told me to rest and follow up with my doctor.

Q: Do you have any pre-existing back problems?

A: No, not that I can recall. I've had some minor stiffness from sitting at a desk, but nothing that stopped me from working or doing my normal activities.

Q: Thank you. Is there anything else you'd like to add?

A: No, I think that covers it. I just want my car repaired and my back to get better.

Q: Understood. We'll be in touch with next steps. Thank you for your time.

A: Thank you.
